item.title: Stocks rally worldwide as oil prices ease on hopes for a possible end to the Iran war
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Stocks are climbing worldwide, and oil prices are easing Wednesday as hopes build that the war with Iran could end soon. The S&P 500 rose 0.7% and added to its leap from the day before , which was its best since last spring.
